summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with the loader and private helper _resolve_path, exported it via an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Not run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed per instructions. Line lengths were checked by hand and none exceed 120 columns. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError, and a top-level JSON value that is not an object is treated as a missing key. No commits were made.
